message:
I remember the last time a storm rolled through, I was completely unprepared. I rushed to gather candles and flashlights only to find half the batteries were dead. This time, I took a little time to get my act together and put together a go-bag with essentials. I even included some of my favorite family photos and important documents, just in case. 

It felt nice to know I was ready, not scrambling at the last minute. Sometimes, being prepared just means a little planning and some peace of mind. Have you ever found yourself on the other side of preparedness?
